decisions.reason: As a cheese close to the firm's core organic dairy range and still prominently presented after launch, it benefits from prior investment and visible commitment, so management is likely to continue backing it unless clear failure becomes undeniable.

Because this spicy cheese was expanded into a product line with several models and given its own page, the firm has made a stronger resource and public commitment to it and would be inclined to justify and continue that commitment.

This mild creamy soft cheese fits the firm's established competencies and announced growth path, and with no direct evidence of poor performance management would tend to attribute any weakness to temporary causes rather than withdraw it quickly.
